<entry id="S01805">
<head-word>קצי</head-word>
<head-word>קָצָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to scrape</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra M’tsorʿa, Neg., ch. IV, Par. 7 חולץ וקוֹצֶה וטח he must tear out (the leprous stone) and scrape (the wall) and plaster, v. קָצַע.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of figs) 
<italic>to cut, dry, and store; to harvest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Maasr. II, 7 השוכר … לִקְצוֹת עמו וכ' if a man hires a laborer to help him in the fig harvest. Ib. III, 1 המעביר … לקצות if a person brings figs over to his court to prepare them for storage. Y. ib. II, 50
<sup>a</sup> bot. להיות … וקוֹצִין אחת that they eat nine portions and store one; a. fr.—V. מוּקְצֶה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to separate, set aside</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. X, 7 (71
<sup>b</sup>) קוֹצָה לה חלה she may separate the priest’s share of the dough; Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to carry off, reduce, level</italic> a hill.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to V, 11 the fool says, מי יכול לקצות את זה who can level this (mound)?; הריני קוֹצֶה וכ' I will carry off two loads to-day …, until I have levelled the entire mound; Lev. R. s. 19 לקצות … קוצץ; (Yalk. Cant. 989 לפנות … קודח).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּקְצָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cut off, separated</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. B. Bath. III, 5 החורשין המוּקְצִין בפני עצמן the forests (near a township) which are isolated (a plantation detached from the town); B. Bath. 68
<sup>b</sup> המוקצין לה which are separate but opening into it; corrected המוקצין ממנה separated from it; Y. ib. IV, 14
<sup>c</sup> bot. החורשים המוקצין ממנה (not הטרשים; corr. quot. s. v. טֶרֶשׁ).—Esp. 
<italic>to be set aside, be designated for a special purpose and forbidden for any other use</italic> (v. מוּקְצֶה). Sabb. 45
<sup>a</sup> הואיל וה' למצותו ה' לאיסורו as the oil was set aside for its religious purpose (for the Sabbath light), it was at the same time set aside as an object prohibited to be used otherwise (during the Sabbath day). Ib. ולית ליה ה' למצותו and does he (R. Simon) not adopt the opinion that an object set aside for a religious act is forbidden for any other use (for the time being)?; a. e.—Part. מוּקְצֶה q. v.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01806">
<head-word>קְצֵי</head-word>
<head-word>קְצָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to cut, break into pieces</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Lev. II, 6 Ar. (ed. רסיק).—Y. Ber. VI, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. כד הוה קָצֵי הוה טעים וכ' whenever he broke bread, he tasted (carrying a piece to his mouth) with his left hand, and distributed with the right hand. Ib. VIII, 12
<sup>a</sup> bot. [read:] יהב ליה עגולה דיִקְצֵי he handed him a loaf to break it. Y. Sabb. VI, end, 8
<sup>d</sup> [read:] קְצִינָן פלגא וכ' we broke off one half and gave it to him; a. e.—B. Mets. 108
<sup>a</sup> מאן קַצְיֵיה, v. קוּץ III ch.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַקְצֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to set aside, make unavailable for any other purpose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Succ. 37
<sup>b</sup> כי אַקְצְיֵיה מריחא אקצייה when he designated it (the myrtle branch) for religious use, he made it unavailable for smelling; מאכילה אקצייה made it unavailable for eating. Bets. 31
<sup>b</sup> אַקְצִינְהִי, v. שְׂרַג or שְׁרַג I.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to place in a corner</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. f. מַקְצְיָא. Yoma 17
<sup>a</sup> האי לשכה אַקְצוּיֵי מקציא וכ' that cell was situated in an angle (south-west corner); to him that came from the north it appeared to be in the south &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְקְצָאִי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be set aside, be made unavailable</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 43
<sup>a</sup> מיגו דא' לבין השמשות א' וכ' since it was forbidden to handle it at twilight (when the Sabbath entered), it became so for the entire day; Succ. 46
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. למצותה א' it was designated only for the religious ceremony (and forbidden for any other use until the ceremony has been performed); לכוליה יומא א' it is unavailable for the entire day (even after the ceremony has been performed); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01814">

<entry id="S01816">
<head-word>קְצִיעָה</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָצַע) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>cutting and packing figs, fig-harvest</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Maasr. II, 7; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<plural-form>pl. קְצִיעוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>figs packed</italic> or 
<italic>to be packed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ter. IV, 10 בדורס ליטרא ק' וכ' if one has packed a litra of figs (of T’rumah) on top of a barrel and knows not of which; Tosef. ib. V, 11; Bets. 3
<sup>b</sup>; Zeb. 73
<sup>a</sup>. Taan. 28
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. IV (III), 7 לעשות ק' הללו שתי וכ' to make of these figs two balls; Y. ib. IV, 68
<sup>b</sup> bot.; a. e.—[Maasr. III, 4; B. Mets. 21
<sup>b</sup>, v. קְצִיצָה.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>store, capsule</italic>,] 
<italic>a compartment of the T’fillin</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 1 משיתיר … בין ק' וכ' when he detaches one compartment from the other on three sides; [El. Wil. emends: קְצִיצָה q. v.]—[Y. Ned. III, 38
<sup>a</sup> קציעות, v. קָצוֹעַ.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup>
<pgbrk id="pg1406" />ק' … כקציעה she was named K., because her savor spread like that of cassia.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>sing.</italic>).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01819">
<head-word>קְצִיפָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָצַף) 
<italic>anger</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lam. R. to V, 20 ק' הושב ע"י וכ' the prediction of God’s anger was contradicted by Isaiah (Is. LVII, 16). Ib. 22; ib. to I, 2, v. מְאִיסָה; Pesik. Vattom., p. 130
<sup>b</sup> קצפין (read: קִצָפוֹן). Esth. R. to I, 18 כדי … לק' הזאת this shame is enough to cause such anger.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01820">
<head-word>קְצִיצָא</head-word>

<senses>

<italic>cut, figure</italic>; (cmp. French taille) 
<italic>waist</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Esth. I, 2(3) כולהון … בני ק' חדא all of them of the same height …, of the same figure.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01821">
<head-word>קְצִיצָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָצַץ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>cutting, felling</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 91
<sup>b</sup> אילן העומד לק' (Ms. F. לִיקָּצֵץ) a tree which must be cut. Lam. R. introd. (R. Z’ʿera) שבו זמן ק' יפה וכ' on it (the 15
<sup>th</sup> of Ab) begins the good season for cutting trees for fuel, v. מַאֲכוֹלֶת. Bekh. 34
<sup>b</sup> (in Chald. dict.) איכוין … בהאי ק' וכ' he intended to make himself appear clean by cutting off (the leprous spot), and the rabbis punished him for this very cut (so that he could never be declared clean from this cut-off leprous spot); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>stipulation</italic> (
<italic>of price</italic> &c.), bargain.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. 45
<sup>b</sup> ק' ודאי וכ' stipulations of prices one surely remembers, v. קִיצוּתָא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<plural-form>pl. קְצִיצוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>cut fruits</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Maasr. III, 4 מצא ק' בדרך ואפי' בצד שדה ק' (Ms. M. קציעות) if one finds cut fruit (single berries) on the road or even beside a field where cut fruit has been spread to dry; B. Mets. 21
<sup>b</sup> Var. (ed. קציעות).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="S01821">קְצִיצָה</xref> a. next w.) 
<italic>the capsule of the T’fillin</italic> containing Biblical sections.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 24
<sup>a</sup>. Succ. 26
<sup>b</sup> top. Kel. XVIII, 8 התיר ק' וכ' if he opened the first of the four compartments of the T’fillin and repaired it; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. קְצִיצִין,</plural-form> v. next w.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>separation, severance of connection</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="S01839">קְצָצָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01822">
<head-word>קְצִיצִים</head-word>
<head-word>קְצִיצִין</head-word>
<pos> m. pl.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָצַץ, cmp. מוּקְצֶה) [
<italic>stores</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>capsules, pods</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Shebi. II, 6 אם עשה ק' גמורין וכ' (Var. קְצוּצִים) if the plant has produced ripe capsules (or pods) before the New Year; Y. ib. II, 34
<sup>a</sup> קְצָצִין.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>capsules containing Scriptural portions, T’fillin</italic>, (v. 
<xref rid="S01821">preced.</xref> 4).</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 57
<sup>b</sup> sq. ארבעים סאה קְצִיצֵי תפלין וכ' Ar. (ed. קְצוּצֵי; Rashi to Succ. 26
<sup>b</sup> קיצוצי) forty S’ahs of capsules of T’fillin were found on the heads of those slain at Bethar; Lam. R. to II, 2 קצוצי; Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>a</sup> top קצוצי.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01825">
<head-word>קָצִיר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> קָצַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>cutting, harvest, ripening season</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> ק' של שביעית וכ' a ripening in the Sabbatical year which goes over into the eighth year, i.e. plants which were partly ripe in the Sabbatical year are subject to the laws of the Sabbatical year. Ib. קְצִיר העומר the cutting of the ʿOmer (v. עוֹמֶר); a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 18 (ref. to Is. XVII, 1</notes></sense>

<number>1)</number>
<definition> קְצִירָן של מלכיות (קְצִירִין) the cutting down (destruction threatened) by the government; ק' של יסורין by sufferings; קְצִירוֹ של מלאך וכ' the cutting down by the angel of death, v. 
<xref rid="N00234">נִדְנֵד</xref>; Yalk. Is. 287.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. קְצִירִין,</plural-form> v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01826">

<plural-form>Pl. קְצִירֵי</plural-form>. R. Hash. 16
<sup>a</sup>; Ned. 49
<sup>b</sup>, v. מְרִיעַ. Gitt. 56
<sup>a</sup>, v. נְקַט; a. e.—[קציריא, Targ. Is. VII, 3 ed. Wil., v. קַצָּר.]—[Y. Shebi. VI, 36

<entry id="S01827">
<head-word>קְצִירָה</head-word>

<italic>cutting, harvesting</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah I, beg. 15
<sup>a</sup> קְצִירַת שבולת וכ' the cutting of the first ear has the same effect (on the duty of leaving a corner) as the striking off of the pile has (on the duty of giving T’rumah). Sabb. 70
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01828">
<head-word>קָצַע</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>

<entry id="S01883">
<head-word>קָרֵב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to join, come near, be near; to be offered as</italic> קָרְבָּן.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. VIII, 2 יִקְרַב לשם מי שהוא let it be offered in behalf of him to whom it may belong. Ib. 5 אם ק' … יִקְרְבוּ וכ' if one of the heads has been offered, let all of them be offered. Ib. 67
<sup>b</sup>; Ḳinnim III, 3 חטאת קְרֵיבָה למעלה וכ' the sin-offering may have been offered on top and the burnt-offering beneath it. Men. VI, 1 הקומץ ק' … קְרֵבִים לעצמן the handful (of the priests’ meal-offering) is offered separately and the remainder separately; Y. Sot. III, 19
<sup>b</sup> top קְרֵיבִין. Sifré Num. 29 קבע זמן לקריבים … למקריבים a time is fixed for the things to be offered (Lev. XXII, 27), and a time for those who offer (Num. VI, 10); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to come before court; to sue, complain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 96 (ref. to ויקרבו, Gen. XLVII, 29) כאדם … ק' על וכ' as one says, that man has brought suit against his neighbor, v. קָבַל II; Yalk. ib. 156 קבל (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>קֵירֵב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same, same, 
<italic>to come near</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 20, beg. לא קי' אצל וכ' he had not come near Sarah.—Esp. 
<italic>to approach; to pray, intercede, mediate, conciliate</italic>. Y. Ber. IV, 8
<sup>b</sup> top זה שעובר … בא וקָרֵב עשה קרבנינו וכ' we do not say to him who is to pass before the ark (v. תֵּיבָה), ‘come and pray’, but, ‘come, draw near’, (which means) ‘do our offerings’, ‘satisfy our needs’ &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring near; to befriend, attract, invite</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 24
<sup>a</sup> ק' נגיחותיו if the ox did his gorings in near intervals (of less than three days). Eduy. VIII, 7 אין אליהו … לרחק ולְקָרֵב … המְקוֹרָבִין בזרוע וכ' Elijah shall come not to decide between clean and unclean, nor to expel (declare genealogically degraded) and to receive (reinstate), but to expel those who have been received by force, and to reinstate those who have been expelled by force. Ib. משפחת … וקֵרְבָהּ בן וכ' there was a family … which Ben-Zion expelled by force, and another which they received by force (Bab. ed. וקֵרְבוּהָ בני וב'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40); Tosef. ib. III, 4; Kidd. 71
<sup>a</sup>. Eduy. l. c. לא לרחק ולא לקרב וכ' neither to expel nor to reinstate, but to make peace &c. Sabb. 31
<sup>a</sup> קֵירְבָנוּ תחת וכ', v. עִנְוְתָנוּת. Ib. שקֵרַבְתַּנִי וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שהקרבתני) thou hast brought us near &c. Tanḥ. Tsav 8 (ref. to Ps. LXV, 5) אשרי מי שבחרו … קֵרְבוֹ blessed he whom the Lord has chosen, although he did not bring him near; Num. R. s. 3 הקריבו. Ib. ק' את עצמו he brought himself near (to God, through his own deeds); ib. יתרו קרבו הקב"ה the Lord brought Jethro near (caused him to be converted); Yalk. Ex. 379; a. fr.—Sifré Num. 94 (expl. לזרא, Num. XI, 20, cmp. זָר) שתהיו מרחיקים … מְקָרְבִים אותו you will keep it at a distance (loathe it) more than you have been inviting (wishing for) it; Lev. R. s. 48.—Part. pass. מְקוֹרָב; 
<plural-form>pl. מְקוֹרָבִין,</plural-form> v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִקְרִיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring near, receive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Dem. II, 23
<sup>a</sup> top מַקְרִיבִין לכנפים, v. כָּנָף. Num. R. l. c.; Sabb. l. c., v. supra; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to offer, sacrifice</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. XIII, 10 יַקְרִיבֶנָּה במקדש he must offer it in the Temple (of Jerusalem), ואם הִקְרִיבָהּ וכ' but if he offered it in the Temple of Ḥonyo (in Egypt). Zeb. 67
<sup>b</sup> ותַקְרִיבֶנָּה למעלה and let her offer it on top, (v. supra Kal); Kinn. III, 6 ויַקְרִיבֶנָּה וכ' Mish. (Bab. ed. ויקרבנה, corr. acc.) and he (the priest) must offer it &c. Ber. 6
<sup>b</sup> כאילו ה' תודה as if he had offered a thank-offering. Ib. 17
<sup>a</sup> as long as the Temple stood אדם חוטא ומַקְרִיב וכ' a man sinned and brought a sacrifice; ואין מקריבין וכ' yet only its fat and its blood were offered; כאילו הִקְרַבְתִּיו לפניך וכ' as if I had offered it (my fat and blood) on the altar before thee; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִקְרַב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be offered</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Meg. I, 70
<sup>c</sup> top ונִקְרְבוּ מהן וכ' and from their contributions was taken the wood for sacrifices; (Y. Taan. IV, 68
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Shek. IV, beg. 47
<sup>d</sup> וקרבו).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְקָרֵב, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְקָרֵב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be brought near, be received</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 3 יש נבחר ונדחה ונ' וכ' some are chosen and repelled (disgraced) and received again &c. Sifra Tsav, Milluïm ידע משה שנ' אהרן Moses learned that Aaron was received again (in grace); Yalk. Lev. 515; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be offered, sacrificed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. l. c. שלא יהא קרבן מִתְקָרֵב וכ' that none but their contributions should be offered first. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXI אותו האיל … ובא להִתְקָרֵב וכ' that ram … ran and came to offer himself as a sacrifice in place of Isaac &c.; Yalk. Gen. 101; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to claim relationship</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Deut. R. s. 2 אם קרובו עני … פלוני מתקרב לי if a man’s relative is poor, he makes himself the main person and him subordinate, saying, this man claims relationship to me; Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>b</sup> (in mutilated text) ההן פלן מתקרב לן.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01884">
<head-word>קְרֵב</head-word>
<head-word>קְרֵיב</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be near, come near, touch</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Num. XXVII, 1. Targ. Ex. XXXVI, 2. Targ. I Kings II, 1; a. fr.—Pesik. Zakhor, p. 24
<sup>b</sup> קריב לגביה, v. בָּלַם II. Eduy. VIII, 4 דיִקְרַב במיתא he who touches a corpse; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to intercede, protect</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Dem. I, 22
<sup>a</sup> בני קרתי קוֹרְבִין לי (not קרתיה) fellow-citizens, protect me!; בני דודי קורבין לי (not דידי) children of my friend (the Lord), protect you me!; Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>c</sup> top בני דילי וכ' (corr. acc.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to complain, sue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Bath. IX, beg. 16
<sup>d</sup> אתון בנוי קַרְבוּן וכ' his sons came and complained before R. E. Ib. אתת וקְרֵיבָה וכ' she came and complained &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring near; to offer</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>קָרֵיב, קָרֵב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring near; to offer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XLVIII, 9, sq. Ib. 13 (Y. ed. Vien. קְריב; h. text ויַּגֵּשׁ). Targ. 
<pgbrk id="pg1411" />Is. LVIII, 3 (h. text תִּנְגּשֹׁוּ!). Targ. O. Lev. I, 2 יְקָרֵיב (Y. יִקְרַב). Ib. 3 (Y. יַקְרִיב 
<italic>Af.</italic>). Ib. 14 (Y. also יַקְרִיב); a. fr.—Gitt. 56
<sup>a</sup> סבור רבנן לקָרוּבֵיה the rabbis were of the opinion that it should be offered. Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>d</sup> top הוה … אתי למִיקָרְבָה וכ' (or למִיקְרְבָה) when a man came to offer, to the idol, an ox &c. Y. Snh. X, 29
<sup>b</sup> מְקָרְבָא לגיחזי to bring Gehazi near (befriend him again). Num. R. s. 3 אלהכון מאן הוא בעי מְקָרֵיב does your God bring near him (grace) whomever he chooses to? B. Bath. 168
<sup>a</sup> אפי' צורבא … לְקָרוּבֵיה even in the case of a young scholar whom it may be supposed his intended father-in-law likes to bring into his family; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְקָרַב; f. מְקָרְבָא, מְקָרְבָה; 
<plural-form>pl. מְקָרְבִין; מְקָרְבָן</plural-form>
<italic>near, friendly</italic>. Sabb. 104
<sup>a</sup> מ"ט שקר ק' מיליה אמת וכ' why are the letters of שקר (falsehood) near together (in the order of the alphabet), and those of אמת (truth) far apart? Snh. 29
<sup>a</sup> מק' דעתיה he is friendly, v. רְחַק.—3) 
<italic>to intercede, lead in prayer</italic>. Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX חזיוה לחזנא דקָרֵיב וכ' they noticed that the officer of the synagogue led in prayer and said &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַקְרֵיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to bring near; to offer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Mal. II, 12; a. fr.—Gitt. l. c. אי מַקְרְבִין ליה (or מְקָרְבִין 
<italic>Pa.</italic>), v. קָרְבַּן. Ḥag. 8
<sup>b</sup> האי דלא אַקְרְבִינְהוּ וכ' the reason why they did not offer them was &c.; a. fr.—Yeb. 39
<sup>b</sup> איקרבת ית וכ' (read: אַקְרִיבַת) she brought before us (the court) such and such a person &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְקָרֵיב, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְקְרִיב, אִיקְּרִיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to approach, come near</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. XX, 3; O. ib. ed. Berl. (oth. ed. קריבין). Ib. XXV, 9; a. fr.—Keth. 56
<sup>a</sup> משום אִיקָּרוּבֵי דעתא הוא והא אִיקָּרְבָא דעתא (when a man promises his bride an additional jointure,) it is in order that an attachment be formed; well, now, the attachment has been formed (and we have a right to assume that he wanted his bride to get that addition, even if he should die before the wedding).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to claim relationship</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="S01883">preced.</xref></definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>

<notes> Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>a</sup> top (ref. to Deut. IV, 7) ק' בכל מיני קריבות (God is) near in every way of nearness (at all times, in all places, in sympathy &c.). Snh. 9
<sup>a</sup> נמצא … ק' וכ' if it appears that one of the witnesses is a near relative (of the defendant) or disqualified. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> אדם ק' אצל עצמו ואין וכ' every man is considered a relation to himself, and none can incriminate himself. Ib. 10
<sup>a</sup> אדם ק' … ואינו ק' אצל ממונו a man cannot testify against himself, but he is not a relative to (disqualified to testify against) his property. Ib. III, 4 היה ק' ונתרחק if a person was a relation (by marriage, so as to be disqualified), and became a stranger again. B. Mets. 39
<sup>a</sup> שבוי … מורידין ק' וכ' if a person has been carried off captive, they (the court) appoint a relative to manage his estate. Ib. ק' מחמת ק' an indirect relative (e.g. one’s step-brother’s step-brother); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קְרוֹבִים, קְרוֹבִין</plural-form>. Gitt. 14
<sup>b</sup> ק' למלכות connected with royalty, influential. Snh. III, 4 ואלו הן הק' the following are considered relatives (disqualified to act as judges or witnesses); a. fr.—Sabb. 152
<sup>a</sup> ק' נעשו רחוקים near objects have become distant (my senses are dull from old age).—[Tanḥ. B’shall. 18 ועברה קרובים; Y. Taan. II, 66
<sup>a</sup> top שהגיע לקרובין, v. קָרוּכִין.]—
<italic>Fem.</italic> קְרוֹבָה. Y. Ber. l. c. ע"ז נראית ק' ואינה וכ' the idol is apparently near, but in fact distant. Esth. R. to III, 1 Haman reflected in his heart אם אסתר … קְרוֹבָתִי if Esther is a Jewess, she is my relative. Meg. 14
<sup>b</sup> חולדה קְרוֹבַת וכ' Huldah was a relative of Jeremiah’s; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קְרוֹבוֹת</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 18 נשא … מקְרוֹבוֹתָיו וכ' if a man marries one of his relatives, of him it is said ‘bone of my bones’ (Gen. II, 23). Lev. R. s. 18 רחוקות נעשו ק' ק' וכ' distant objects have become near (things that I could discern at a distance must be brought near me), near objects have become distant, v. supra; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
